objective: LungVision AI — Phase 6C Independent Research Model Reproduction & Generalization Audit.
acceptance_criteria: Gate A: Checkpoint & Experiment Reproduction (Identify exact Model D checkpoint, verify SHA-256, config, manifest; declare PARTIAL if 512x512 dedicated checkpoint missing; export phase6c_checkpoint_reproduction.json).
Gate B: Controlled Preprocessing Comparison (Compare direct resize vs aspect-ratio letterbox; train/eval matched configs without domain mismatch; export phase6c_preprocessing_reproduction.json).
Gate C: Resolution Reproduction (Audit 224 to 512 resolutions; verify trained checkpoints exist; correct AUROC vs sensitivity confusion; export phase6c_resolution_validation.json).

Gate D: Statistical Validation (Patient-cluster bootstrap CIs resampling patients rather than images; paired comparisons with effect sizes and multiple-testing correction; export phase6c_patient_cluster_statistics.json).

Gate E: Calibration Evaluation (Per-class Brier score, ECE, reliability diagrams, slope/intercept, precision-recall curves; fitted strictly on validation data; export phase6c_calibration_report.json).
Gate F: Operating Point Validation (Evaluate Frozen NIH, Youden J, and High-Sensitivity Triage with patient-cluster CIs; non-diagnostic disclaimer; export phase6c_operating_point_validation.json).
Gate G: Error Analysis (Audit false negatives for Pneumothorax, Cardiomegaly, Edema, Atelectasis and Pneumonia/Consolidation confusion with Grad-CAM and metadata; export phase6c_error_analysis.json).

Gate H: External Evaluation & Final Report (Evaluate on independent CheXpert cohort; document label differences; export phase6c_external_evaluation.json and author authoritative PHASE_6C_INDEPENDENT_REPRODUCTION_REPORT.md declaring COMPLETE/PARTIAL status).
non_goals: Do not overwrite or modify production DenseNet121 weights (SHA-256: 8d3690cd0438587a94afb8fd2ad84c0b30f9c1cc2727ee0eb03662a02ea020af)
Do not alter frozen NIH production classification thresholds
Do not overwrite Phase 5B through Phase 6B artifacts
Do not use test data for calibration or threshold tuning
Do not claim clinical diagnostic validity or external 3D reconstruction validation from CXR datasets
